title: DongbaMIE: A Multimodal Information Extraction Dataset for Evaluating Semantic Understanding of Dongba Pictograms
reasoning: The paper introduces and benchmarks models on a new dataset (DongbaMIE) which is derived from Naxi Dongba Manuscripts. These manuscripts are primarily religious texts of the Dongba religion. The information extraction task includes identifying and understanding religious entities and activities such as 'priest', 'sacrifice', 'gods', and 'celestial deity'.
